Close-up photo of RAM sticks showing brand and capacity.

response.reason: The photos show a gaming PC case with RGB lighting, but no component branding or model numbers are visible. All seller claims about CPU, RAM, storage, and GPU are unverified. Without proof of the components, the system cannot be priced accurately and may be misrepresented. The risks include incorrect or missing components, which would significantly affect value.
